coverage_exempt.E233: extension backstop: the current sealed-container verifier rejects every non-member at E131 before projection; this remains the fail-closed default for a future ProtocolMember extension
coverage_exempt.E237: projection self-check over freshly emitted OIR: every public path admits PIR first, so an input cannot intentionally create phantom, unlicensed, or missing coverage without bypassing the production boundary
coverage_exempt.E904: generator self-check over freshly emitted output: the family emits a vocabulary and a spine and then admits them through the same loaders the tools ship, so reaching this needs a defect in the generator rather than an input. It stays live and fail-closed because that is the defect it exists to catch
